app.footer: For authorised hospital staff · Contact your facility's IT support for access help
connection.label: Connection status
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that. If you think you should, contact your administrator.
errors.invalidInput: Some details need checking. Please review the highlighted fields.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact IT support.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.intro: Shared components and design tokens. Development only; contains no patient data.
auth.error.invalidCredentials: The staff ID, email or password isn't right. Check and try again.
auth.error.locked: Too many attempts. Sign-in is paused for 15 minutes. If you need access sooner, ask your administrator.
auth.error.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts from this computer. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.error.disabled: This account has been switched off. Please contact your administrator.
auth.error.noRole: This account has no role yet. Please contact your administrator.
auth.error.sessionExpired: That took too long, so sign-in was stopped for safety. Please start again.
auth.error.signedOut: You've been signed out for safety. Please sign in again.
auth.error.wrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again.
auth.error.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; enter the one showing now.
auth.error.invalidRecoveryCode: That recovery code didn't work. Each code can be used only once.
auth.error.enrollmentRestart: Setup needs to start again. Select “Show setup code”.
auth.error.serverUnavailable: The hospital server didn't respond. Check the connection and try again.
auth.password.tooShort: Use at least 10 characters. A short phrase is easier to remember than random symbols.
auth.password.common: That password is too common and easy to guess. Choose something less predictable.
auth.password.containsIdentifier: Don't include your staff ID or email in your password.
auth.password.reused: Choose a new password, not the temporary one.
auth.status.label: System status
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signIn.intro: Use your hospital staff ID or email.
auth.verify.title: Verify it's you
auth.verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
auth.verify.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up your authenticator. Each code works once.
auth.verify.lowCodes#one: You have {count} recovery code left. Ask your administrator to reset your authenticator soon.
auth.verify.lowCodes#other: You have {count} recovery codes left. Ask your administrator to reset your authenticator soon.
auth.verify.neverShare: Never share your verification code with anyone.
auth.enroll.title: Set up your authenticator
auth.enroll.intro: Your role needs a second sign-in step. You'll need an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. It works without internet.
auth.enroll.scanTitle: 1. Scan this code with the app
auth.enroll.qrAlt: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
auth.enroll.manualTitle: Can't scan? Type this key into the app instead
auth.enroll.confirmTitle: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
auth.enroll.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Write them down and keep them somewhere safe and private. They won't be shown again.
auth.enroll.codesSaved: I have saved these recovery codes
auth.changePassword.title: Choose a new password
auth.changePassword.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
auth.changePassword.hint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase works well.
auth.unreachable.title: Server unreachable
auth.unreachable.body: This device can't reach the hospital server right now.
auth.unreachable.noticeTitle: New sign-in needs a connection to the hospital server.
auth.unreachable.noticeBody: For patient and staff safety, signing in is only possible while the server can be reached.
auth.unreachable.help: Check the network cable or Wi-Fi, or ask your facility's IT support for help.
auth.unreachable.protections: Your access protections stay in place while the system is unreachable.
auth.lock.title: Screen locked
auth.lock.intro: Locked after 10 minutes without activity, to protect patient information.
staff.placeholderBody: The {role} workspace arrives in a later release. You're signed in and your session is protected.
users.error.cannotDisableSelf: You can't switch off your own account.
users.error.lastAdmin: This is the only active administrator. Add another administrator first.
users.error.cannotResetOwnMfa: Ask another administrator to reset your authenticator.
users.error.adminExists: An administrator already exists. Create accounts from the admin screens instead.
